description:
Create a new Script in Vicidial to integrate an external CRM via iframe, and configure the 'SALES_Q1' campaign to use it.

Script Details:
- Script ID: ORDERFLOW
- Script Name: OrderFlow Integration
- Active: Y
- Content: An HTML iframe pointing to 'https://orderflow.internal/lookup?phone=--A--phone_number--B--&rep=--A--user--B--'

Campaign Configuration:
- Edit the existing campaign 'SALES_Q1'
- Set 'Campaign Script' to the new ORDERFLOW script
- Set 'Get Call Launch' to 'SCRIPT' so it opens automatically on call connect.
